findings.description: Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-03. Document explicitly shows Official Seal/Signature/Stamp = N/A and narrative states 'UNOFFICIAL INFORMATIONAL COPY... does not bear the embossed official seal, authorized registrar signature, or stamp'. Worker only restated the generic dependent-child requirement and flagged no defect (expected verdict: defective).

Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-02. Registration date 2025-05-20 for a 2010-03-12 birth (15-yr delay), 'Pending Local Civil Registry Review', provisional/preliminary credentials, unassigned civil register number. Worker flagged no defect (expected: defective).
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-02 (scanned variant of the delayed-registration record). Same 15-year late registration and pending/provisional status; Worker produced only the generic requirement and no defect.

Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-01. Short-form abstract with Parent Names/Father/Mother/Proof Of Relationship = N/A and narrative 'SHORT-FORM CARD DOES NOT CONTAIN PARENTAL INFORMATION'. Worker flagged no defect (expected: defective).
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-03 (scanned sibling of 0d8e...). Seal/signature/stamp N/A, unofficial unvalidated printout. Worker flagged no defect (expected: defective).
Missed PFL-BIRTH_CE-01 (vector sibling of 6bee...). Missing all parental fields; short-form abstract. Worker flagged no defect (expected: defective).

Correctly detected the untranslated-Spanish defect, but the defect claim cites completeness-check.md#024 with a quote about the dependent-child document requirement, which does not substantiate a translation/certification requirement. Citation does not support the asserted defect.

Basis references internal failure-mode identifier 'PFL-BIRTH_CE-04', a taxonomy code from privileged research not present in the public corpus or the document. This exact-match code suggests non-blind context; a blind Worker should describe the defect without citing internal failure IDs.

Translation-defect claim cites completeness-check.md#024 whose quoted text concerns the dependent-child document requirement, not certified-translation rules; the citation does not resolve to support the specific defect asserted.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require an explicit authenticity/completeness verification pass on the attached document, not just restating the generic requirement. Mandate emitting a defect claim when any of: (a) official_seal, issuing_authority_signature, or issuing_stamp is 'N/A'/'Preliminary'/'Provisional'/'Pending' or narrative says 'unofficial/unvalidated' (CE-03); (b) registration_date minus date_of_birth exceeds ~1 year or authority is 'Pending Review' (CE-02); (c) parent_names/father_full_name/mother_full_name/proof_of_relationship are null/N/A or narrative says 'short-form/abstract without parental information' (CE-01); (d) document_language is not English/French without certified translation + translator affidavit (CE-04).

For each defect claim, require a citation whose quoted text actually states the violated rule (e.g., translation/certification, official seal, late-registration corroboration). Do not reuse the generic dependent-child 'document required' quote to support authenticity or translation defects.

Prohibit emitting internal failure-mode taxonomy codes (e.g., 'PFL-BIRTH_CE-04') in Worker output; blind Workers must describe defects from document evidence and public corpus only. Emitting such codes indicates non-blind context leakage.

rationale: Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) reliably restated the correct generic dependent-child birth-document requirement with a consistent, plausibly-official corpus citation and kept applicant PII inside basis[] (claims/prose clean, e.g., d2464043). However defect recall is the dominant failure: it detected only the two translation defects (ad9e/c2979) and missed 6 of 8 injected defects entirely — all CE-01 short-form (6bee/8989), CE-02 late-registration (3de3/5c00), and CE-03 missing-seal (0d8e/70db) cases — despite unambiguous document and narrative evidence. Both clean cases (64bc, d2464) were correctly not flagged (no false positives). The two detected-defect cases have citation mismatches (the #024 quote does not support a translation rule), and c2979 additionally leaked an internal failure-mode ID (PFL-BIRTH_CE-04), a blind-compliance concern. Net: strong grounding/PII hygiene but severe under-detection driven by treating the task as a knowledge lookup rather than a document verification.
